_comment: Baseline material library for generate_assembly_bom (dana.plugins.manufacturing.bom_exporter). density_g_cm3 is the nominal solid density; cost_per_kg is a ballpark raw-stock price in the listed currency (filament spool for FDM, bar/plate stock for CNC) for early estimates, not a quote. Edit freely; keys are matched case-insensitively, as are aliases.
